notes.title: The new update is here: A new map!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Some Synergy just received a new update.
The new update features a new map.
It is designed to be more beginner friendly!
Hope everyone enjoys the game
Thank you!

notes.title: Upcoming Update: New map
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Some Synergy will receive an update around September 5th!
The main new content will be a new map.
The new map, titled "New", is designed for beginners.
I recognized that the game was too difficult for many people, so I decided to add a new map that is easier.
Besides that adjusting the difficulty will also adjust the platform friction as well.
I plan on making other changes as well.
Hope everyone look forward to it!

notes.title: Now there are 3 difficulties
notes.notes:
Now there are 3 difficulties: easy, normal, and hard.
Besides that, I also adjusted the normal difficulty to be easier.
I also added few other changes for convenience of the player as well.

notes.title: Now you can adjust the difficulty!
notes.notes:
Now you can adjust the difficulty!
There are 2 options: easy or normal.
I've also made few changes regarding overall difficulty of the game as well
The demo version is also updated as well.
Have fun!
